acceptance.method: diagnostic (generate with-guide vs isolated baseline, LLM judge vs rubric acceptance)
acceptance.verdict: Both agents converted all four values correctly to rem (this task has no px-allowed edge cases to distinguish them); the guide added a bit more rigor — an explicit rule citation and a verification grep — while the isolated agent padded the answer with an unrequested, hedged guess at token variable names, so the guide's version is marginally cleaner but not meaningfully more correct.
